title: Members and encapsulation — one screen
rememberThis: A class variable holds a reference; assignment copies the reference. A struct assignment copies the data.
Properties are the public surface; fields stay private. C# 14 field synthesizes the backing store in an accessor.
Learn ordinary parameters first, then ref/in/out. init and required pin construction. Finalizers almost never — module 14. Extension members — module 10.
bullets: Default member accessibility is private; default type accessibility is internal. file is file-local types.
Primary constructors (C# 12) capture parameters for the type body; required properties force object-initializer completeness.
readonly struct plus in parameters avoid defensive copies on hot paths (cache keys, coordinates).
params collections (C# 13) accept more than arrays. Operator overloading is last; C# 14 adds user-defined compound assignment.
